studies.title: BTC time-series momentum
studies.question: Did switching between BTC and cash after a 20-session rise earn enough to cover trading costs?
studies.finding: Momentum finished behind the annually allocated BTC/cash account after base costs. The predictive-return and net-Sharpe intervals both include zero.
studies.dataset: Bitstamp BTC/USD spot, Kaggle v706 normalized by ff137
studies.next_action: Inspect the base-case intervals and the three recorded cost assumptions.

studies.title: FFT spectral entropy gate
studies.question: Did filtering the same momentum decisions by the entropy of the previous 64 returns improve after-cost performance?
studies.finding: The gate reduced average exposure and net return relative to plain momentum in this sample.
studies.dataset: Bitstamp BTC/USD spot, Kaggle v706 normalized by ff137
studies.next_action: Compare the filtered and plain rules within the same retrospective run.

studies.title: Transaction-cost break-even
studies.question: At what fee and slippage levels does the historical momentum comparison change sign?
studies.next_action: Freeze a common multiplier for one-way fees and slippage, a bounded range, and separate Sharpe and wealth crossing criteria.

studies.title: Turnover-aware momentum
studies.question: Can a slower decision schedule or separate entry and exit thresholds reduce turnover enough to improve net outcomes?
studies.next_action: Predeclare a small set of schedules and thresholds, including equality and initial position rules.

studies.title: Dynamic portfolio allocation
studies.question: Can a bounded BTC weight based on momentum strength or past volatility improve the risk and return tradeoff?
studies.next_action: Specify lagged inputs, position bounds, rebalance timing and costs before comparing allocations.

studies.title: Cross-asset validation
studies.question: Does the result persist in another market with independently qualified prices, accounting and execution assumptions?
studies.next_action: Freeze the asset roster, then qualify data rights, calendars and market-specific accounting before collecting results.
